(iii) where the caveator is a holder of a Power

of the original of the Power of Attorney

as the “Registrar”); and

National  Identity  Card  number  or  the
passport number or the driving license
number and address  of the caveator in
Sri Lanka at which notices relating to
the caveat shall be served, the date of
the caveat, the names and addresses of
the persons to whom the notice of the
caveat shall be sent where the caveator
